work_package: S1-WP3 — Add one durable owner-task contract
ending_worktree_state: dirty; only scoped S1-WP3 implementation, tests, report and baton changes are uncommitted; ignored generated appshak_state remains ignored
objective: Establish one durable owner-task identity, assignment and lifecycle above WP2 execution attempts without treating execution success as validated completion.
task_contract: SQLite owner_tasks row with UUID, owner, objective, opaque authority, idempotent source request, assignment and timestamps; explicit trusted local CLI create/assign/inspect; creation does not dispatch.
persistence_changes: Task row, history, artifact references and linked attempt transitions commit in the existing SQLite substrate; source events remain transport, not task truth.
schema_changes: owner_tasks, owner_task_history, owner_task_artifacts; nullable execution_attempts.task_id; idempotent migration preserves WP2 rows.
assignment_behavior: Owner and matching task authority assign once to agent and ToolGateway workspace identity; assignment source/time persist; no scheduling or reassignment.
attempt_linkage: Optional task_id is carried through ToolRequest/AgentRuntime/ToolGateway to WP2 attempt reservation. Task existence, state, worker, workspace and authority are checked transactionally. Multiple attempts per task are representable.
event_history: task_created, task_assigned, task_execution_started, task_execution_succeeded, task_execution_failed and task_needs_reconciliation are durable SQLite history records with prior/new state, actor/source and attempt ID.
failure_behavior: FAILED and TIMED_OUT attempts make task EXECUTION_FAILED; no implicit replacement attempt.
unknown_outcome_behavior: Unknown outcome or expired running lease makes task NEEDS_RECONCILIATION in the same transaction as the attempt fence; no blind replay.
retry_policy: No automatic retry policy added. Duplicate source/key replays a known terminal result; new attempts in failed, unknown or ready state are denied.
authority_continuity_status: PASS — task assignment binds existing WP1 authority/worker/workspace while each WP2 attempt retains its own authority_id, source_request_id, worker, workspace, operation and timestamp.
restart_status: PASS — persisted states and assignments survive reopen; startup attempt reconciliation updates linked tasks only when WP2 attempt truth requires it.
golden_workflow_status: PASS — real command worker writes exact content in a temporary worktree; reopened store retains ready task, assignment, attempt, publication/acknowledgment and artifact path reference.
tests_run: python -m py_compile on changed Python files
nonblocking_findings: Owner-task CLI is a trusted local operator interface, not an authenticated remote owner service.
Artifact references are paths only; no persisted hash, acceptance verdict or validated completion exists in WP3.
Manual unknown-outcome resolution, task reassignment and retry policy are not implemented.
The existing .gitignore ignores .appshak/; BATON-0005 exists but needs explicit force-staging in the later checkpoint.

Explicit owner intake and inspect path without automatic dispatch.
Persistence, idempotency, authority, migration, state, fencing and real worker restart coverage.
